title: Annota theme (.annota-theme), format 1.x
description: A theme for Annota's quick styles: 2-8 colours, a heading font and a body font. Shared between users and installations: imported by users, installed for every user into /usr/share/annota/themes by an administrator. Readers of format 1.x accept every minor version: unknown keys at any depth are preserved and written back when the theme is saved or exported again. A higher major version is refused ('unknown schema version'). A file has no id: themes are told apart by where they are installed and their file name.

format.description: Format version MAJOR.MINOR. Minor versions only add optional data.

requires.description: Oldest Annota release that reads this format ("0.1" for format 1.x). Informational.

name.description: Shown in the theme list and the theme switcher.

colours.description: The palette, in order. The first colour is the default colour of every tool; colours 1-3 shape most generated quick styles. #RRGGBB, or #RRGGBBAA.

fonts.description: Font family names. A family that is not installed falls back like any text in Annota.
